Bob Hardaway was born in Milwaukee on March 1, 1928. He played clarinet and tenor sax during his military service and joined Ray Anthony’s group in the early 50s. Bob has played with a long list of top band leaders including Woody Herman, Benny Goodman, Stan Kenton and Bud Shank. He has recorded with Bob Florence and still performs in the Los Angeles area.
Bob was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 14, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Los Angeles. My name is Monk Rowe and I’m pleased to have veteran musician Bob Hardaway with me.
